policy: One 0.5 px centered outline subtraction (0.25 px inward on each edge) for both colorshifted heading lines, preserving Matrix glyph advances, size, alignment and existing shadow settings. Chosen from calibration ink-density measurements and verified with the actual native painter on frozen scan poses. No per-card adjustment. All values use the 488x680 logical face.
densityPolicy: Within fixed glyph-local windows, blur by sigma .45, normalize foreground coverage against local 30th/98.5th grayscale percentiles, and measure ink coverage and RMSE. This separates stroke weight from printed hue/saturation. Edge/chamfer scores are regional similarity indices, not whole-card accuracy.

rejected.reason: MSE Matrix Medium reduces weight but changes relative glyph advances and loses held-out overlap. ModMatrix does not change these heading outlines.

review: Remaining title/type baseline and individual glyph discrepancies are outside this weight-only change.
A few type-line edge scores regress by less than 1.1 points; both cohort means and ink-density measures improve.
